1.message: guide antipatiche, una in particolare anche poco disponibile.

Wycieczka nie spełniła moich oczekiwań, ponieważ odbyła się niezgodnie z planem. Wycieczka jest reklamowana jako piedras rojas, podczas gdy ta atrakcja się nie odbyła. Agencja mimo wiedzy, że Piedras Rojas są niedostępne, nie poinformowała o tym uczestników. Niestety, wciąż nie otrzymałam zwrotu środków za tę część wycieczki ani za lunch, który również nie miał miejsca.
Cancelaram na noite anterior e nem explicaram o motivo. Só não dou 0 estrela porque é impossível.
No vinieron para recogerme. Perdí oportunidad de visitar el lugar ya que solo tenía pensado hoy para este tour. Estoy muy triste y enojado de lo irresponsable fueron.

Probably the worst experience I have ever had. Our trip to Piedras Rojas got canceled. Not their fault. We went to Lagoon Chaxa and after that we were told that because of inclement weather, the rest of the tour had to be canceled. The issue is that the provider has been unresponsive since this happened. I’m still trying to get my money back. The Tour Guide was amazing and she was sweet and knowledgeable and did everything in her capacity to make us feel comfortable. However, the Tour operator was indifferent from the start - curt and barely responsive. We found out later that they just partner with the actual tour company(which is decent) but have horrendous reviews outside (look out for the name Rute Chile). They said we did 50% of the tour somehow(outright lying) and refused to give us our money back. I don’t care about the money as much as the principle and the unfairness of it all.

This was a terrible tour in terms of organization. Firstly, the guide and other organizers were ignoring the questions of the guests in the WhatsApp chat which they open for the tour members. We got our answers only after we called and warned that nobody is answering. Secondly, early in the morning they didn't bother to wait for all of us to gather in the hotel to pick up us even for 5 mins and left me in the hotel though they got back again only after I called them back and told them that I so how they were leaving the hotel and could not stop the bus to get in. Finally, it was freezing during the tour, the weather was very cold, but all the guides were very well prepared for themselves but not the majority of the members of the tour.... Nobody told the tourists that it will be - 4° and we needed to get dressed accordingly... This was totally unacceptable, disappointing and disrespectful. I would never advice to take this tour with this company and guide Valentin.

Avoid at all costs!! We paid upfront and they never turned up. We sent flight details twice only to be ignored on messages for a week. So we were stranded trying to figure out how to get to our hotel 1.5 hours away Then a few days later they said they didn’t receive the info - this was not true at all, they clearly forgot us and got their backs up when I complained. Awful company

Nobody picked me up, nobody answers my questions in the app and in WhatsApp, nobody wrote me the day before. I was waiting outside in a cold from 6 to 8 am (time of picking up is 6-6:40), nobody came!!!!!
Keine Antwort auf Nachrichten, keine Abholung. Äußerst enttäuschend.
The company didn’t pick up us nor answered our calls. We waited for almost one hour outside for the tour but they didn’t show up unfortunately

Tour was outsourced from Layana Travel to Andes Travel (which they only mentioned after we had already paid). Guide (a mid aged lady) was rushing people at literally every moment, also a very controlling person - to the point where she wanted to dictate (no, not suggest) the points where people should take pictures, also saying that people should take pictures as couples so that they would be more fast/efficient - god forbid people take individual photos! The place is obviously beautiful and is a must go (best views of atacama), but I would avoid layana travel / andes travel if you care for having a guide that knows how to behave with tourists. I mean, of course when you are with a group you have to be mindful not to slow down everyone, but that gives no right for a guide (or its assistant, which claimed to be “only following orders to rush people”) to keep pressing people at every minute of the day. No better way to ruin an awesome place with great views. Run from this agency.

Guide did not show up. No contact from trip organizer. Nothing. Strong feeling that trip operator is a scam operation Refund ... Obviously no response. STAY AWAY FROM RUTA CHILE AND HET UOUR GUIDE. SCAM OPERATIONS.
the company never picked me up. pick up was for 6 to 630 am. no messages. Will try for refund
No communication from company or provider. Pickup was missed as 40 minutes earlier than advertised on this website

I did a reservation for a tour 2 months in advance not having a hotel booked yet. A mail with hotel details and birth date request was sent by a tour agency on reservation date. Since that time no reminder was sent. One day before the trip they sent an urgent request that info should be provided and then sent me another mail in 30 min that I didn’t answer on time and my tour was cancelled because of no show case. I found it extremely customer unfriendly. No refund was provided, nevertheless, no strict deadlines to provide the mentioned info were communicated anywhere in advance. Be careful this timing and the agency’s communication style.
La agencia no pasó por mi! Ni se pusieron en contacto conmigo, y no me han bonificado lo que pagué.
Nessuno si è presentato, siamo rimasti senza attività e abbiamo perso un giorno ! Non fidatevi di questo tour

Absolute nightmare. I booked a tour and was patiently hoping for information as it was promised. Nothing. I wrote to an agency as I was alarmed that Piedras Rojas were closed due to bad weather and that many agencies were cancelling tours. They did not email, they did not respond to my texts. I got in touch with Getyourguide and they themselves could not reach the company! I received an email at midnight from Getyourguide that the tour would happen so I waited at the pick up point at 7 am. No one arrived for half an hour, I immediately informed Getyourguide which also unsuccessfully tried to reach Ruta Chile. After Getyourguide said it was not okay to be that late and said I am okay to cancel, the pick up arrived. Half an hour late! And the driver was from another company (!!!), he said he did not the situation, he could not help. The weather changes a lot in this part of Chile. You have to have an agency which responds and that you can trust. The day is completely ruined.

2.message: por razones climáticas hubo que cambiar un tour esencial de 170 dolares por uno corto y básico sin que hubiera compensación de la empresa en cuanto al valor pagado. Tenemos que agradecerles que al menos hicieran una excursión alternativa aunque muy menor. de todo un día a medio día, de contar con almuerzo a un desayuno , no se recibió más comunicación de la empresa que las razones climáticas y ahí tienen la alternativa. No se dijo rechacela y le reembolamos. estando acá había que tomarla, no nos quedó otra opción. aunque hayamos perdido al menos 100 dólares más almuerzo.

This was one of the most expensive tour options between the cost of tour + entrance fee. We were expecting more information along the way and at the sites and higher quality food options for breakfast and lunch to set it apart from the other tours. We just explored each site on our own without much commentary and did not consume much of the food due to it being mediocre. The driver and guide did point out wildlife along the way which was nice. Do make sure to bring altitude medicine and plenty of water in case you get sick. All in all, we did not feel the cost and value were on par. Would recommend doing research on the in town options and booking in advance or when you arrive.

My main reason for booking this tour was the flamingo reserve. However, this was closed during the week I was doing the tour (this is of course not the tour agency's fault). The tour was then shortened in a way that we were just driven back to San Pedro after lunch. It's ok to make that change although the price should have been lowered. But the main problem was that we were only told about the change when we were already on the tour. This way we didn't have the option of opting out and do something else that day. So they managed to not only waste my money for the short tour but also my time on a tour I would not have wanted to join if told the updated itinerary.

3.message: Die Tour war gut, interessant und die Infos vom Guide ebenfalls! Ich fand nur den Preis für das, was wir an dem Tag gemacht haben, im Endeffekt zu hoch Das Frühstück und das Mittagessen war lecker und abwechslungsreich. Für 5 Stopps, einer dafür 1 1/2 Stunden und die übrigen nur Fotostopps, war der Preis zu hoch
Guide désagréable j’avais l’impression de les déranger .. trop nombreux ds groupe

Honestly it didn’t even feel like 10 hours, the day flew by. Our time was filled with great sights and scenery and meals. Nicolas is a great guide, knowledgeable about the geology and history of the area and passionate about its preservation. Our driver was safe and efficient. Recommend this trip!

Nel complesso un bel tour, posti magnifici ed una guida disponibile. Tre stelle solamente perché non siamo stati avvisati anticipatamente della chiusura del parco Petra Rojas e dell’impossibilità di raggiungere Minique. La tappa “alternativa” alla Jere Valley nulla di che, evitabile.
very expensive for what is it, our guide was great, but the tour as such its just average

The activity got better throughout the day. It took us 1 hour and 15 minutes to leave town because they had not sorted out breakfast before picking us all up. The tour also said there would be a maximum of 10 people but we had 14. The stops we made varied in value. The main events were good, but the roadside places were not that interesting.

We did not receive any info about pick up time from the hotel. The communication with the activity provider was null and they even refused to inform us about transfer info when asked. However, the trip was very nice and the guide was ok.
Chaxa ist ausgefallen. Und alles auf schlechtem Englisch.

Passeio longo, mas o guia que nos acompanhou fez com que se tornasse leve, paisagens e fotos incríveis. Só tenho um ponto com q alimentação. O restaurante que paramos para comer não era bom, sujo e a comida se condições de comer.

4.message: Guide, food, sights and scenery excellent. The mini bus was full with 14 guests. As last pickup the seats at back very uncomfortable squashed in for a long day day. Really dont think is reasonable for price and time in van. Everything else great
A guia era muito boa, valeu a pena o passeio. No geral achei que alguns lugares não valem tanto a pena, mas no geral foi bom.

ガイドは英語を話す参加者が少ないため、ほとんどスペイン語で話していました。良い景色のところで写真を撮ってくれたのは良かったです。ガイドの男性の一人は、一人参加者にも気を配ってくださり親切でした。 ツアー前日まで問い合わせをしても連絡がないのが不安でした。また、アタカマで色々なツアーに参加しましたが、このツアーだけチップの要求がありました。 しかし、朝食・昼食ともに美味しかったですし、一日で遠距離を色々と回ることができて充実したツアー内容でした。
Leider hat die Guida nicht viel an den Piedras Rojas, was ja das Highlight der Tour ist, erklärt. Und die Kirchen haben wir auch nur von außen gesehen.
Door Sheryl hebben we een leuke en informatieve tour gehad! Fijn om zoveel kennis te krijgen en te zien hoe gepassioneerd het werk wordt gedaan.
They did not provide a good communication on pick up schedule during the morning. I had to wait 40 m8nutes as O was the last to pick up

Buena excursión. Lugares exceptionnelles. Vimos algunos animales de la región. Muy lindo. Desayuno y almuerzo ricos y copiosos. Me hubiera gustado q el guía nos explicara o nos contara más cosas de todo lo q vimos.

i luoghi visitati sono meravigliosi. il bus comodo e il cibo incluso buono. Rispetto al prezzo proposto da altre agenzie per lo stesso itinerario abbiamo pagato molto di più. Rispetto ad altri tour non siamo stati informati via WhatsApp in anticipo dell'ordine di raccolta dai vari hotel. La guida era molto pressante
Muy bien organizada y espectaculares las vistas. Quizá un poco largo el tour y con algo de prisa.

Very nice and interesting tour, we were first at all places and got to enjoy it in a better way. The guide and driver were super nice, good energy and were willing to take all photos for us. All food, drink and spots to enjoy it were very good. Only issue is that this company I booked in here didn’t give my correct phone number to the guide and I almost lost the tour at pick up. The group was from another agency that was very good, so not sure this evaluation will work for everyone that books in GYG.
tot en general, la activitat una mica curta i el almuerzo una mica senzill

guida preparatissima. panorami fantastici. tour organizzato bene. il sistema escursioni in san Pedro è un po' monotono. poche possibilità di scelta, tappe obbligate. questa escursione "full day" risulta un po' vuota al ritorno in città. tre tappe maggiori (splendide) e poche possibilità di fare deviazioni o vedere posti vicini ma interessanti.
Guide und Fahrer Top aber Organisation vor Ort durch Atacama Magic office katastrophal und chaotisch!!!

Overall the tour was good: we were picked up at 6:35am & drove 30 mins to have breakfast - they had scrambled eggs, cheese, ham & avocado sandwiches. After that we drove to the Salar where we spent 20 mins & saw flamingos. Next was Piedras Rojas (had 30-40 mins) and it was absolutely impressive. Finally the two lagoons at 4200m were incredible. We then drove back for lunch - vegetarian meals were good (see pic). We were dropped off in the centre around 4pm. The nature is truly impressive and I cannot recommend it enough! It is mostly above 4000m & you might feel unwell (one person from our group did & they almost cancelled the lagoons visit but someone got really upset & insisted we went - there was no other way but to take the person with us.. they had no other solution) What to improve: we were all told to be ready at 6am, at 6:05 they sent the order of pickup which would have been helpful to know the day before.. also the breakfast location was gross with lots of trash around.

Ich hatte Probleme mit der Höhe von 4100m - hatte auch nicht gelesen dass das irgendwo erwähnt wurde. Mir war übel, Kopfschmerzen und Kreislaufprobleme. Die Guides haben sich zwar gekümmert, aber dann haben sie mich mitten in San Pedro abgesetzt statt 10min Umweg zu Hotel zu fahren. Ich musste dann durch die Hitze laufen mit meinen Problemen.

This trip was cancelled due to the snow preventing access to Piedras Rojas. But we were quickly offered a different lagoons and salt flats trip and given a refund for the difference. Friendly guide and excellent breakfast/lunch. We needed to get back to our hotel quickly and the guide kindly got us a cab. We would recommend.

replies.text: It's the best we can do under the circumstances. Thanks for your opinion.

4.message: C’était bien
Tout était bien dommage qu'on n'a pas pu aller à piedras rojas
it was beautiful. the salt flats were amazing.

Belle excursion, magnifique points de vue et repas et pdj très bien. Par contre, nous étions à 6 heures devant notre hôtel et la amionnette est arrivée à 6h30. Dommage de ne pas nous avoir prévenu dans la discussion whatsapp. Sinon bien prévoir des vêtements chauds il fait très froid. Attention après l'excursion, on vous dépose à l'agence au centre pas de retour à l'hôtel.

In the mail that I received from you the tour operator was mentioned as Ruta Chile. However, it was outsourced to another tour operator who was below the usual GYG standards. Our tour guide spoke mainly in Spanish and just a little bit in English, which was inconvenient for us, since we don't speak any Spanish. The tour bus was not very well maintained and one passenger even complained that there was spider on her seat. The pickup was from our hotel, but the drop-off was at a different location and this was not conveyed to us. I've been a regular GYG client and I felt that you should know that the regular standards were not met and that was
piedras Rojas is stunningly beautiful

The guide was nice and informative, and helpful. The tour felt a bit rushed. The meals were quite basic (especially breakfast) and the itinerary is organized in a way that lunch is VERY late and by then you are starving. Bring snacks! The places visited are amazing.
Fabulous scenery. Nice breakfast and very good lunch. Very hot in van coming back. Enjoyed seeing Vicunias and other animals en route. Long day.
The experience was really nice, the places are amazing and the guide was extremely lovely and helpful. The only point was the breakfast and lunch quality - not very good
Tres beau coucher de soleil sur la vallée de la lune
Very good and knowledgeable guide open and friendly. Very confident in the driver Nice guys Very little by way of improvement
Enjoyed it yet it was not as expected
Tte bien et des commentaires interessants.
Great tour to see many parts of the Atacama. Arrangements were good, and tour guide and driver very friendly and professional.
Guide and driver were very good, food was pretty good for being included. Scenery was nice but nothing too exciting. Kind of a long day - overall a fine trip but not particularly memorable.

Marco our guide and Luis our driver were very professional and informative about the sites we visited and at spotting various local animals. However, the company didn’t reply to my emails the previous day requesting what time we would be picked up and how much cash to bring to pay for the entry fees. We only received a WhatsApp message from our guide Marco half an hour before we were picked up around 6am.

We had a great time on this all-day tour through the salt flats and altiplanic lagoons! The Piedras Rojas and the Chaxa Lagoon are must-see sights in the Atacama desert, in my opinion, and this tour is an excellent way to see them both in one day. The van was perfectly comfortable, and our guide Mano was very clear and entertaining. We were lucky to see quite a few different species of desert animals (foxes, rabbits, emus), which we loved. The food was simple but good. The one wrinkle was that the pickup time was not communicated very clearly. CHECK YOUR EMAIL the day before for a notification of when to expect the pickup. My partner and I saw it and were ready when the van came at 6am, but many other parties thought that the pickup was at the time listed on GetYourGuide at 7am and MISSED THE TOUR. So definitely pay attention to this -- we ended up leaving almost an hour behind schedule because of the time we spent waiting at hotels for people who missed the pickup.
paisagens

Die Aktivität und das Naturspektakel an sich ist ein Traum und absolut empfehlenswert! Unser Guide hat allerdings das Gefühl vermittelt, dass er die Tour nur im Zeitplan durchhetzen will! Leider war die Kommunikation mit dem Veranstalter ( Layana Tour ) schlecht! Ich bekam lediglich am Abend vorher auf eine ganz andere Buchungsnummer die Abholtzeit, glücklicherweise war ich inzwischen erfahren genug um nicht nervös zu werden! Steckt euch wirklich dicke Kleidung ein auch dies wurde nicht besonders hervorgehoben! Das Essen am Ende der Tour hätte man sich sparen können! Es war schlecht und absolut überflüssig, da es direkt danach nach San Pedro zurückging

Angefangen hat unsere Tour nicht gut. Wir haben vom Anbieter, eine Abholzeit bekommen jedoch hat sich herausgestellt, dass dieser uns die falsche Zeit mitgeteilt hat. Somit mussten wir eine Stunde am Abholpunkt warten. Erst nach mehrmaligen versuch den Anbieter zu erreichen, haben wir die Information bekommen, dass wir erst später abgeholt werden. Die Tour selbst war ausgezeichnet. Wir konnten die Flora und Fauna von der Atacama Wüste bewundern. Auch das Frühstück und Mittagessen war sehr gut. Der Guide (Chris) war sehr gut und konnte uns über alles bestens informieren (er hat sich auch bei uns entschuldig bezüglich des Fehlers am Morgen). Wir können die Tour auf alle Fälle weiter empfehlen, da sie sehr spannend und schön war. Jedoch würden wir auch dazu raten schon im vorhinein mit dem Anbieter Kontakt aufzunehmen um die richtige Abholzeit abzuklären.

Good tour. Long stretch from the breakfast at 7.30am to lunch at 2.30pm. Everyone should be advised to bring food and water because there are no places to buy anything. The bus was extremely hot in the afternoon. The tour company doesn’t say how much you need to bring money in cash to pay one entrance to a park (40.000!). We didn’t have enough money and had to walk around at the end of the tour to find a place to withdraw money. The places are beautiful and worth seeing, and the tour guide was very nice. But in comparison to other tours it was very unorganized.

Nous avons apprécié les différentes étapes du tour. Nous regrettons seulement qu’il n’y ait pas davantage de quantité de boissons proposées sur le tour vue le prix et le fait que nous n’ayons pas été ramenés à notre hôtel contrairement à ce qui nous avait été indiqué par l’agence Layanas quand nous sommes passés régler le complément la veille du départ. Carolina notre guide était très agréable et notre chauffeur Robinsohn très discret.
Passeio foi otimo, mas havia uma taxa de entrada não explícita na descrição do passeio, de 15 mil pesos chilenos

Cuidado! O que está escrito na descrição no site não é o que falam para você na hora do tour. Por exemplo: não deixam na volta no seu hotel, tivemos que provar o que foi comprado aqui no site para eles fazerem. Outro fato é de não confirmarem o passeio no dia anterior como descrito no site. Eles não adiantam o valor da entrada dos parques, e não tem em nenhum lugar no site do governo do Chile. O almoço ficou a desejar, era prato feito e não foi igual para todo mundo. A poltrona que pegamos não funcionava o cinto de segurança. A vã precisa de uma revisão. E como a viagem é longa, necessita de cortinas, o sol escaldante na volta não foi agradável. Na lagoa dos flamingos, havia uma rota mais longa que não quiseram fazer, pois iria demorar! Apesar de tudo, os destinos foram mágicos.

Lugares maravillosos, poco tiempo para apreciarlos bien, muchos traslados y cuando dicen que pasan a pueblos no se puede conocer nada ahí. Debo destacar que la atención del equipo fue excelente y perdí un artículo en la Van el que fue devuelto sin problemas. Muy bien ahí ya que genera confianza

I wanted to give the full rating, cause our tour guide (mauricio) and driver were excellent. The only and huge problem was the lunch. We are vegetarians and told specifically after being asked in the office. The lunch was supposed to be vegetarian but there was chicken. We were able to eat the leftovers from breakfast, but our group had 4 vegetarians out of 7 people. Besides that it was an amazing day.
Belle journée à 4000m, superbes paysages sur les volcans et lacs
4.enjoyment: La variété des endroits visités et le guide top!

4.message: Muy buen tour por los lugares y el guía. El chófer también con la mejor actitud... La falla está en el agencia. Nunca confirmaron si pasaban por mi o yo iba a algún punto de contacto, yo tuve que hablar con ellos y además me dijeron que pasaban por mi entre 6 y 6 30 am y pasaron a las 7 10... 40 minutos más para dormir.
4.enjoyment: El guía y los lugares que visitamos

4.message: It is a long day, many km on the bus but the places are something you won't easily forget, especially the lagoons at 4300 meters of altitude. Having breakfast (including freshly cooked eggs) in front of that view at that altitude is something unusual for most people and was very much appreciated! We were lucky and we met also several species of wild animals on our way. The staff (guide and a bus driver) was friendly and prepared, ready to answer all questions and trying to involve all passengers.

5.message: Amazing trip with knowledgeable guide. Highly recommended. For me one of the best trips in my whole life.
Top melhores tours do atacama. A guia Celinda foi excelente, sabia de tudo para nos ensinar e foi extremamente competente. O desayuno e almoço foram muito bons também!

Circuit d’une journée complet, des arrêts intermédiaires supplémentaires pour photos auraient peut-être pu se faire. Guide, chauffeure et accompagnant très bien, à l’écoute. Repas pique-nique à l extérieur très bien organisé, produits bien cuisinés et locals .

It was an amazing day with tour operator Atacama Magic. Denny our guide was informative and fun. Breakfast and lunch were well done by the crew. Tour started and ended on time. Such amazing beauty in the Atacama Desert! Highly recommend.
Precioso
Une très bonne expérience
Było super , dziewczyny były niesamowite ! Extra wycieczka !
Incredible tour with incredible guides! Cannot recommend it enough. Some of the most magical places I’ve ever been to.
perfect group, perfect guide, amazing views. just an unforgettable day. would do it again
We really had a good time on this tour! Our guide was amazing and gave us interesting information for the areas we visited.
The guide made the trip
ottima esperienza
Sehr schöne Tour mit wunderbaren Stopps. Unser Guide David war sehr nett und immer hilfsbereit. Außerdem war er sehr motiviert und hat viel Interessantes erzählt.
Breathtaking scenery. Delicious meals. Dress warmly!
Todo excelente, recomiendo el tour
Paysages magnifiques, guide plus que sympathique et intéressant sans oublier le très bon chauffeur . Excellente journée dans des décors plus beaux les uns que les autres. Je recommande grandement.
L’excursion était top. Merci au guide Nicolas pour son accompagnement et ses informations très claires et précises. Le repas était excellent avec plusieurs spécialités locales.

Our guide, Pablo, was very kind and friendly. His English explanations were sometimes a little difficult to understand, but whenever we asked, he was happy to explain things again. I’m sure his explanations would be perfect in Spanish! He also showed us some great viewpoints and took some really nice photos for us. The lunch was delicious, too. It was a wonderful tour where we could fully enjoy the breathtaking nature of Atacama, from the foothills of the Andes to the flamingos on the high-altitude plateau. Highly recommended!
Me emcantooooo

Guide Sheryl und Fahrer waren sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit! Die Stopps waren beeindruckend und vielseitig! Das Essen war lecker und ausreichend, jedoch war das Wetter recht windig und kühl und das Frühstück als auch das Mittagessen wurden draußen angerichtet. Durch den Wind war es während dem Essen recht staubig und nicht windgeschützt. Bei der Abholzeit wäre es zudem gut einen genaueren Zeitslot als 40 Minuten vorzugeben, beziehungsweise die Reihenfolge der Hotels nicht erst 5 Minuten vor Abholung bekannt zu geben.

Foi um passeio simplesmente maravilhoso! A explicação foi excelente, tornando toda a experiência ainda mais especial. Conheci paisagens que parecem verdadeiras pinturas, com tons de água que eu nunca imaginei que existissem. Cada lugar foi uma surpresa e me deixou encantada. Amei absolutamente tudo!
Amazing, really nice guide !
Guia Celinda é a melhor fotógrafa do mundo! Além disso é uma pessoa incrível e a melhor guia dentre todos os passeios que fiz! Amei tudoooo, foi perfeito!
Excelente a experiência! Deslumbre total!

Visitamos varias lagunas, cada una con características particulares. La guía Ximena súper atenta y explicaba a detalle cada sitio y el camino, sin duda, enriqueció la experiencia. Todo estuvo muy bien coordinado

Tutto molto bello, escursione meravigliosa, trasporto ottimo e buon cibo, il tutto accompagnato da Ximena, la nostra guida simpaticissima, sempre sorridente e molto preparata sulla cultura, la storia e la natura Cilena. Raccomandatissimo
Long day trip but well worth it as it covered a lot and helped with acclimatisation to altitude
Excelente

Vraiment une expérience très intéressante et inoubliable ! Sheryl était une excellente guide, très à l’écoute, attentive et avec énormément de connaissances. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié ses explications et sa façon de partager son savoir. Je recommande vivement cette expérience !

Our tour guide was amazing! He had such a good sense of humour and was knowledgeable about the area! They catered to my coeliac allergies and for that I was extremely grateful. Pro tip: dress in hiking clothes and layer up be prepared for cold wind and then a warm afternoon!
A really informative tour and an enjoyable day out! The breakfast and lunch that are provided were also amazing!

Brilliant trip! Watching the sunrise in the desert with breakfast was really nice. The places we visited were beautiful. Our guides were really good at making sure we got the photos we wanted, and explaining about the history of the places. Our driver was so lovely and stopped multiple times on the journey so we could look at various animals we saw along the way. The flamingo lagoon was amazing! And the lunch at the end was also really good.
Awesome day out. A highlight of our trip. Our guide was really good as well

Hemos aprendido mucho, Ronald, nuestro guía, nos ha explicado todo genial y nos ha hecho pasar un día genial con el humor que tiene y contagia. La experiencia merece muchísimo la pena, es precioso y paisajes que nunca habíamos visto. La comida y el desayuno también muy rico. Carla, nuestra otra guía, también ha sido súper amable y se preocupaba porque viéramos todo lo que nos habían comentado en las explicaciones, así como ayudarnos a hacernos fotos en todo momento.

Hot food cooked on the spot. Communication before the tour was also excellent. Follow my travel blog at https://donotgogentlytravel.com/

Une journée dense mais des paysages incroyables, une super organisation (pick-up à votre hôtel, stops visites, p’tit dej et déjeuner), et une guide incroyable Sheryl (motivée, cultivée, et qui aime tant faire découvrir son pays), on recommande!

O tour foi espetacular, além dos lugares serem esplêndido, os guias se esforçaram para que visitassemos todas as atrações nos melhores horários e antes que outras agências chegassem, portanto pegamos todos os lugares de início vazios, isso fez com que a contemplação das paisagens fosse ainda mais prazerosa e não houve pressa por parte deles. Os guias Alonso e Paula foram pontos chave para o sucesso desse passeio, ambos extremamente cuidadosos com todos que estavam no passeio, respeitando o limite físico de cada um, além de nos deixarem muito a vontade. Eu estava viajando sozinha e me senti extremamente acolhida por ambos, pela Paula que se voluntáriou a tirar minhas fotos e vídeos, sendo extremamente atenciosa e paciente, além de conseguir conversar em inglês comigo, já que não falo muito espanhol, e o Alonso com extremo conhecimento sobre todas as atrações e conseguindo transmitir com muita didática. Além de tudo isso, as refeições também estavam deliciosas, passeio 10/10.
Tudo perfeito adoramos!

This tour was absolutely fantastic and easily the highlight of my trip to Chile. Every stop was breathtaking, especially Piedras Rojas and the Altiplanic Lagoons. The landscapes are unlike anything I've ever seen. Everything was very well organized from start to finish. The transportation was comfortable, punctual, and made the long journey enjoyable. The guide was excellent—very friendly, knowledgeable, and passionate about the region. Throughout the day, they shared fascinating information about the history, geology, wildlife, and local culture, which made the experience much more meaningful. I learned so much. I also loved the atmosphere during the trip. The music played in the vehicle was great and perfectly matched the incredible scenery, making the journey between destinations even more enjoyable. If you're visiting the Atacama Desert, this tour is an absolute must. It exceeded all my expectations, and I would recommend it to anyone looking for an unforgettable experience.

We really enjoyed the tour, we got to see different natural areas of the Atacama, and the tour agency’s team prepared a delicious breakfast and lunch. The guide gave very interesting explanations about the places we visited. The tour was conducted in English and Portuguese, and the guide did an excellent job. A nice bonus was having internet access along the way.Starlink was available, so we could stay connected the whole time.
Passeio muito legal, com muitas paisagens maravilhosas. Cafe da manhã muito saboroso

Ximena was an amazing guide, every stop we made was amazing and Ximena even altered the route for better chances of seeing more flamingos. Breakfast and lunch were also great. 10/10 couldn’t recommend more!

This tour was really worth it. We had an amazing day, all the stops were incredible. Our experience was even better due to the knowledge and kindness of our tour guide Sheryl. Javier, the driver, was also very friendly! Would absolutely recommend doing this tour with Atacama Magic :)
A equipe e toda a estrutura estão de parabéns!! Recomendo!!

If you want to join day tour to Red Stone, please join this tour, you will not regret it. Thanks to Ronald, his assistant and the driver for giving us a great time during the trip. The guide explained in both Spanish and English, gave us ample time to take photos. Definitely recommended.
Dennis was the best guide and made our experience better. He knows many things,he is friendly, smiling and very helpful. I recommend to everyone this excursion with this agency.
amazing views!!! the guide was fantastic. I highly recommend

It was a lovely time! Kevin & Oscar were wonderful!

An excellent and informative trip. Highly recommended.

Wir wurden pünktlich abgeholt für einen Tag voller unterschiedlicher Erlebnisse: angefangen bei den Roten Steinen und einer wunderschönen Spiegelung der Landschaft im Wasser, über die Seen von Miscanti und Miniques bis hin zur Lagune mit Flamingos. Daneben wurden wir sowohl beim Frühstück als auch beim Mittagessen mit richtig gutem Essen versorgt. Unser Guide Ursula hat alle Fragen geduldig beantwortet. Unser Fahrer Oscar hat uns zügig von einem Ort zum anderen gebracht. Insgesamt ein toller Ausflug, den ich uneingeschränkt empfehlen kann.

A really fun tour! Our guide Nicholas was laid back and humorous, and set a great vibe for the day. Each stop was great, comfortable walking pace and adequate time to take photos and learn about the place. There are toilets at every stop too which is great. Lunch had great variety and considered our dietary restrictions. It was lovely to see the flamingoes too but really sad to see the impact of the international mining companies impacting their habitat with unsustainable practises. My only consideration for improvement was pick up time we were given a 40 minute range, which is not usual with most tours I’ve booked.
Es war einfach nur toll. Der beste Ausflug, den ich bisher in Chile gemacht habe und Sheryl ist mit Abstand der beste Guide!!!

Ich wurde pünktlich am Hotel abgeholt; die Heimkehr endete aber für alle an einem zentralen Platz im Ort. Der Ausflug selbst war gut geplant. Der Fahrer (Ariel) ist sehr umsichtig und gut gefahre. Unser Guide (Name habe ich leider vergessen) brachte humorvoll die Informationen in Spanisch + Enlisch über die verschiedenen Aussichtspunkte herüber.
Excelente passeio , guia muito prestativo, paisagens lindas , e pessoas do Brasil também no passeio

Muy linda excursión, los lugares son espectaculares y muy bien organizado. Excursion extraordinaire pour ses paysages et les différents endroits visites. Le chauffeur Rodrigo et le guide David ont été formidables par leur patience, leur gentillesse et leurs explications passionnantes. un grand merci à eux deux!
Was an amazing tour with a very enthusiastic tour guide! Had a great day and learnt a lot! The scenery was spectacular.

Really nice trip, all cool places, very experience guide, perfect english knows a lot abut history and geology, recommend this tour to everyone plus breakfast and lunch was delicious

Guide mit breitem Wissen Wissen über die Region. Immer ein Witz auf den Lippen und weniger auf Sensation aus sondern möchte gut bzw. solide informieren. Große Abwechslung und die Möglichkeit die Atacama wüsste in der Gesamtheit zu begreifen.

Super organisiert, informative Erklärungen zu den angesteuerten Orten, keine zu langen Fahrten zwischen den einzelnen Stops, leckere Mahlzeiten, enthusiastische und freundliche Reiseleiter. Einziges Manko, dass man am Ende nicht wieder am Hotel abgesetzt wurde.

the food was a very welcoming surprise - delicious!

Mein Freund und ich waren mehr als begeistert von dieser Tour. Der Fahrer Oscar hat uns sicher transportiert und war ein hervorragender Fotograf! Das Frühstück war ausgewogen und lecker und vorallem das frische Mittagessen war sehr vielseitig und bot jedem Geschmack etwas. Auf der Tour haben wir abgesehen von den geplanten Orten oft angehalten um die Flora und Fauna kennenzulernen. Guida molto preparata, attenta e coinvolgente. organizzazione ottima. caratteristica la colazione preparata al momento in un posto carino. soprattutto: posti di una bellezza incredibile. una giornata da riempire cuore, spirito e occhi di meraviglia

El tour a las Lagunas Altiplánicas fue increíble, ¡quedamos encantados! El guía Kevin fue excelente: súper organizado, puntual y con explicaciones claras e interesantes sobre el paisaje, la flora y la fauna del altiplano. Mantuvo al grupo unido todo el tiempo, cuidando especialmente la altitud y el ritmo. Las paradas fueron perfectas: desayuno rico para arrancar el día, almuerzo delicioso y tiempo suficiente para disfrutar de las lagunas y el entorno espectacular. Todo fluyó sin prisas ni esperas. Uno de los mejores tours en San Pedro de Atacama. ¡Gracias Kevin! 100% recomendado.
Fantastic scenery, good range of sights. Cami was an excellent guide. Very good meals provided.

Highly recommended tour! If you get Sheryl as a guide, count yourself lucky. She is a wealth of knowledge and obviously loves sharing it with others.

Christian was just phenomenal. Very lovely and energetic. Both the guides were so talented in organizing delicious breakfast and lunch. very rare tour where nothing felt rushed and were fortunately at the right time everywhere we arrived. The experience felt very intimate where we got to take a lot of photos, learn about flora and fauna. Very good. I will note that the communication from the company (not the guide) could be better. I messaged about our pickup, times, other questions but didn't receive any response and even tried their provided WhatsApp number to no success. I don't want this to affect the rating of our experience as the guides were very hard working and this note is for the actual company. Thank you very very much for such a splendid day.

This tour was amazing! Of all the tours we did in the Atacama Desert, this was by far the best—largely thanks to our wonderful guide, Cheryl, and our driver, Luis. Cheryl made the entire experience so enjoyable. She did an excellent job explaining each location we visited and kept us well informed every step of the way. Her deep knowledge, passion for the history of the region, and commitment to conservation really stood out. Beyond being a fantastic guide and teacher, Cheryl was also hilarious and incredibly entertaining—she kept us laughing all day! Luis was a great driver and added to the overall smooth and enjoyable experience. We couldn’t recommend this tour more.
Great trip, beautiful views and knowledge guide.

Sheryl, the best guide ever!

Nossos guias foram muito bons. Vista simplesmente sensacional, sugiro levar um binóculos (nosso guia Denny emprestou o dele durante o passeio e foi um baita diferencial). Café da manhã e almoço muito bem servidos e muito gostosos! Buscaram pontualmente nos hotéis, porém na volta deixaram todos os passageiros na rua Caracoles (todos achávamos que retornaríamos para os respectivos hotéis). Nada que estragasse a experiência para mim, mas para alguns clientes que estavam mais distantes do local de desembarque foi meio complicado ter que andar kms ou gastar com transporte de retorno após mais de 10h de passeio.

The tour was great, Nico was a great guide, a lot of fun, on time and very knowledgeable and structured in his explanations. He spoke very good English and we were happy to finally experience and English tour here that was not done half in spanish. The food was also very good and the driver too. The sites and scenery are of course breathtaking.

Para mim Piedras Rojas é um dos lugares mais impressionantes que já conheci. O tour foi muito legal, pois demos sorte de ter uma excelente guia (Celinda/Moni), uma boa van, com ótimo condutor e parceiros pontuais e educados. Tivemos um bom café e almoço gostoso incluído. A guia além de explicar muito bem sobre arqueologia, geologia, etc se encarrega de fazer fotos e vídeos impressionantes. Como bônus no passeio vc conhecerá o Trópico de Capricórnio e poderá dar a sorte de ver a fauna local. A ida à lagoa dos Flamingos também foi muito interessante. No geral é um passeio dos mais recomendados que existem em São Pedro. Se tiver q optar, deixe outro menos importante de fora. Olhe o meu Instagram para saber mais @geisonizidio

Excellente organisation de la part de notre guide (Celinda alias Mona): ponctualité, efficacité, prévenance, le tout avec le sourire donc une excellente expérience et des paysages impressionnants. Merci à Celinda & à Johnny pour leur professionnalisme et leur amabilité. Excelente tour gracias a Celinda y Johnny. Paisajes impresionantes, comida generosa, organización extra (desde el pick-up por la mañana hasta el desayuno + el almuerzo + las fotos + la musica + las explicaciones) entonces solo lo puedo recomendar 😉
Sheryl notre guide a été extraordinaire, le déjeuner très bon. le rythme parfait et les paysages incroyables. nous avons adoré

Sheryl knows everything!! She was an amazing tour guide and really brought each stop to life, equipping us with so much information. Luis was a great driver as well. Highly recommend this tour, as all the stops were jaw droppingly beautiful. We couldn’t get enough of the scenery. Cross your fingers for Sheryl and Luis when you book!

The tour was amazing! Sheryl is such a positive, knowledgeable guide, and Luis, our driver, was awesome! I learned a lot during our tour! I would definitely recommend it and would love to take another tour with Sheryl!

Excellent guide (Christian) and driver. Christian was very knowledgeable and passionate about the sites and nature. Able to provide little gems of knowledge and also gave us the best chance of photo opportunity’s based on timing and locations. Amazing!

both driver and guide were very nice. the guide provided a lot of information on the way and the whole trip was well organised. even though it was a long trip it did not felt like that at all. it was a wonderful experience.

Guide and driver were great and worked well as a team. Knowledgeable, did all as per description and more (stopped for photo at Tropic of Capricorn). Didn’t feel rushed, and guide checked on all our welfare when we reached higher altitudes.
Excellent tour. We covered a lot during the time, and the food was great. Special thanks to our guide, Cheryl, who provided an amazing experience!!
We had an amazing time! Sheryl was a great tour guide and very knowledgeable. I would highly recommend this tour
Phenomenal landscape. Everything by went ok and both guide and driver were knowledgeable and friendly. It’s a very long excursion and make sure to bring very comfy shoes.

Our guide Mauricio was very knowledgeable about the area and provided lots of information about local culture, nature and history of Chile & Atacama desert. He explained the altitude sickness and was very attentive during whole trip with advise and looking after us. Breakfast & lunch was delicious - we had various choices of tea/coffee/cacao, cake & vegetarian & meat sandwiches with fresh guacamole. For lunch we enjoyed chicken with potatoes/rice with salads & tortilla. Great memories! Thank you!

We had a wonderful tour with our guide Denny. He was informative but also relaxed and flexible. We covered a lot of ground and saw some stunning scenery, would highly recommend this tour. The breakfast and lunch were also very tasty !
